journey.name: Switch model: the picker persists per chat
journey.description: The model is a property of the chat, so switching it survives leaving the screen and coming back.

actions.action: Type "Reply with exactly: Hello" into the message field and tap send
Wait until a reply bubble appears containing "Hello"
Tap the model chip labelled "Sonnet 5" above the message field
Verify a menu listing "Sonnet 5", "Haiku 4.5" and "Opus 5" is displayed
Tap that chat in the list
